<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/schema-to-markdown.py — do not edit. Regenerate from public/schemas/. -->

A folder in a container's library tree.

A `Group` carries no content of its own — it exists to give a module or campaign structure.
Pages, maps, encounters, references and other groups point at one through their `parentId`,
which is how an adventure gets chapters and a campaign gets sections.

The tree is built from those pointers rather than from a child list, so a group holds no
references downward. Groups nest by pointing at each other through their own `parentId`.

- Note: Deleting a group does not delete what it contains — the orphaned items resurface at the
  top level of their container.

- SeeAlso: `Page`, `Reference`, `Encounter`, `Module`

[View JSON Schema](/schemas/Group.schema.json)

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The unique identifier for this group. A UUID string automatically generated when the group is created. This serves as the primary key in the Realm database, and is what its children carry as their `parentId`. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | The display name of the group. <br>**Examples:** `"Chapter 1: Goblin Arrows"` |
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | A URL-friendly identifier for the group. Used to link to the group as `/group/chapter-1-goblin-arrows`. <br>**Examples:** `"chapter-1-goblin-arrows"` |
| `parentId` | `string` | Yes | The identifier of the parent group, for nesting. Empty for a group at the top level of its container. |
| `rank` | `integer` | Yes | The manual sort position among its siblings. Lower values sort first. |
